title: The tidal Thames through London (Environment Agency)
what: Water level at seven Environment Agency gauges on the tidal Thames from Richmond to Erith, every 15 minutes over the last 24 hours.

schedule.how: once a day at data.b@'s morning wake: one GET per gauge (seven), 2.5 s apart, no key; the page reads the latest levels live in the browser
